purpose: Language-neutral generation SSOT for the 12-item AEO baseline across the 6-site encyclopedia ecosystem. Python generators and TSX components both consume this file directly (see aeo_schema_contract_wiring.md for how) rather than each re-implementing the field rules independently — the fragmentation this file exists to end.

confirmed_clean.note: FAQPage 6-item single block, homepage. D+1 stability check passed — exactly 1 block, no duplication.

Correct shape reference is the component's OWN structured-field render, NOT its pre-fix live HTML — pre-fix live output was contaminated by a duplicate/malformed FAQPage baked into body_html (P0-NEW-1/2, fixed same day, commit 6dd9245, Vercel deploy/ISR still catching up as of contract authoring — do not re-capture from live URL until deploy confirmed, see Task 11 follow-up).

excluded_contaminated.reason: malformed JSON-LD (missing acceptedAnswer, truncated answer text) — never a valid reference, see P0-NEW-2

fixture_arbitration_rule: Any live-output sample proposed as a fixture MUST be cross-checked against (a) whether the exact @type/field shape is produced by the component's OWN independent structured-field render (trustworthy) vs a legacy content-injection pipeline writing into a raw HTML/body_html field (historically the source of every recurrence found 2026-07-31 through 2026-08-15 — FAQPage x3 rounds + this contract's own P0-NEW-1/2 discovery), and (b) whether any known open P0/tripwire affects that site/route as of capture time. Ambiguous cases MUST be escalated to Kira in writing, not self-arbitrated by a model — see Gate 4 Task 6b for the escalation record of this contract's own authoring.

canonical.rule: href must be an absolute URL matching the page's own canonical path (no query string unless intentional).

robots_meta.rule: content must not be empty; must not contain 'noindex' unless the page is intentionally excluded (e.g. password-gated dashboards).

llms_txt_link.rule: site-level, not per-page-unique — presence check only.

og_title.rule: content non-empty, distinct from generic site name.

og_type.rule: content in {website, article, profile} matching page_class.

exemptions.url_path_scope: excludes any URL containing '/insights/' — those routes (japan/hongkong/taiwan/global/macao insights) use InsightPageView.tsx and correctly emit ScholarlyArticle/Article; the exemption applies only to macao's own non-insight pages (homepage, /macao/brand/*, category listings) which use WebPage/CollectionPage by design
exemptions.reason: design choice — uses WebPage/CollectionPage instead of Article/ScholarlyArticle for content pages
exemptions.recorded: SPEC §2 row 8, confirmed by Task1 checker audit; path-scoping added 2026-08-15 after Task8 regression baseline caught the unscoped (domain-only) version incorrectly exempting japan insight pages that DO correctly emit ScholarlyArticle

required_field_details.headline: non-empty string
required_field_details.author: object with @type=Organization or Person, name non-empty

rules: mainEntity must be non-empty (min 1 Question) — a page with FAQPage present but mainEntity:[] is INVALID, not exempt (SPEC §2 row 9 / 2026-06-30 fix precedent).
Every Question's name and every Answer's text must be non-empty, non-truncated strings (P0-NEW-2 precedent: a truncated answer like '該店評分保持在 4.' is a contract violation, not a formatting quirk).

Content MUST be localized to the page's own region — a FAQPage block whose content matches a DIFFERENT region's known Q&A set is a contract violation (2026-07-31 recurrence precedent: Macau FAQ content appearing on japan/taiwan pages).

EXACTLY ONE FAQPage block per page. More than one — even if byte-identical — is a contract violation (2026-08-14 world-encyclopedia duplication + macao P0-NEW-1 precedent, both caused by a legacy content-injection pipeline writing a second copy alongside a component's own structured-field render).

breadcrumb_schema.rule: position values must be contiguous starting at 1, matching actual page depth.

cc_by_4.rule: Marker MUST appear in the page's own rendered HTML — a claim in llms.txt alone (without the marker on the page) does NOT satisfy this check (SPEC §2 row 12 precedent: 4 knowledge sites claimed CC BY 4.0 in llms.txt with zero HTML presence). Kira confirmed 2026-08-14 this IS the intended license — safe to write the marker once this contract is consumed by Step 1-5 site migrations. Until then, verifiers MUST fail-closed (report missing, not silently pass) rather than auto-assume intent.

known_open_items_not_yet_encoded: Malaysia's actual current data (region=MY, separate Supabase source) has not yet been fixture-sampled — Task 5 reconciled the UA-count contradiction but did not capture malaysia's JSON-LD shape. Malaysia is noted in SPEC §8 as the 'clean control group' for FAQPage specifically, worth using as a THIRD fixture source when Step 4 (malaysia full rewrite) begins.
